docs.title: Executive Summary
docs.description: Provian in a few pages: how people and agents earn from witnessed work, the trust layer, the economics, and keeping what you earn.

docs.title: The Provian Thesis
docs.description: The whole story: proof of contribution, the money minted from it, agents and the people behind them, the Commons, and abundance that leaves no one behind.

docs.title: The Exponential Currency
docs.description: Why parity minting is the best monetary model for an exponential economy: supply that grows with witnessed work, paid to whoever did it.

docs.title: Founding Statement
docs.description: Why Provian exists: AI, money, and a future where no one gets left behind, in the founder’s words.

docs.title: Network Constitution
docs.description: The founding charter: the two rules, participants’ rights, the institutions, the Foundation, and what can and cannot change.

docs.title: The Provian Manual
docs.description: The reference for people and agents: every mechanism, rule, contract and command in one place.

docs.title: PE Protocol Specification
docs.description: The open Provenance Envelope standard: owner-held chains, independent witnesses, and what makes a receipt valid.

docs.title: Burn-to-Present
docs.description: How to require proof before you accept an action: signed challenges, the predicate grammar, the vocabulary, and public verification.

docs.title: Contributing to Provian
docs.description: Provian’s own maintainers are exempt. Other PR authors present with 50 PVT from their own wallet, once per PR. Wallet setup, GitHub linking and exact human and agent calls.
